title: Blog post draft: the engineering behind formbook at scale (dot-y5p992)
description:
Bead dot-y5p992 (dotfiles store): write the FIRST BLOG POST for davidaw.ad (this repo, an AstroPaper site): "the engineering behind building formbook at scale". DRAFT ONLY: commit on a branch; never merge, deploy, publish or post to social.

Use the new skill from the dotfiles repo (git@gitlab.com:davidawad/dotfiles.git, readable with this box's deploy key; clone it to /tmp/dotfiles, branch master; if the files below aren't on master yet, fetch branch ops-blogfix-2):
- AI/skills/sdr-blog-post/SKILL.md (end-to-end process) and its leaf skills sdr-headline-hook-writer, sdr-vega-chart-pack, sdr-og-social-card, sdr-citation-finder
- AI/skills/sdr-blog-post/references/what-works-on-the-web.org (the checklist)
- the voice skill AI/skills/write-like-david
- src/rust/crates/sdr-blog-post-lint (build it and lint the draft; fix until it exits 0)
- DATA: AI/skills/sdr-blog-post/examples/formbook-data/ (README.org says what each file is and its gaps). Headline numbers: 805 newbox runs on 567 formbook tasks (782 claude, 23 codex); 299 boxes released (219 Hetzner, 80 AWS) on Oct 14-15; peak 90 concurrent boxes fleet-wide at 2026-10-14T23:23Z; 722 commits from 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-14; 417,591 lines added; templates 0 -> 489 (README says 479 folders across 233 courts); local token ledger 96.9M tokens since Oct 13. GAPS you must state honestly in the post rather than invent: box-side tokens and total cost are not recorded; the Hetzner-only peak isn't computable.
- How templates work and how to contribute: read the formbook repo (git@gitlab.com:davidawad/formbook.git, or find it in dotfiles projects/registry.json, id formbook): README, CONTRIBUTING, the typst template layout under courts/, and how tests validate a template. If you can't clone it, say so and describe only what the data README states.

Post requirements (David): optimized for social; a strong hook; MULTIPLE Vega-Lite charts (specs + rendered SVG/PNG checked into the post's assets): boxes per day, cumulative templates over time, commits per day, the claude vs codex run split, the fleet concurrency curve with the 90 peak marked; 2-3 citations to external studies or data (URLs that load); an OG/social card image; SEO title/meta/slug; social copy for X, LinkedIn and HN in a sidecar file (not published). Follow this repo's content collection conventions (src/data/blog or src/content; frontmatter schema), with draft: true in the frontmatter if the schema supports it.
Verify: the site builds (npm/yarn per the repo's lockfile; `astro build` or the repo's build script) and the post renders; screenshot the post page if playwright is available. Commit on branch blog/formbook-at-scale with a conventional message referencing dot-y5p992. In the final result, list the post path, the charts, the citations, and every number with its source file.

title: Site template: emit og:image:alt/width/height and honor frontmatter canonicalURL
description: Found while drafting formbook-at-scale (dot-y5p992). Layout.astro emits og:title/description/url/image + twitter card but no og:image:alt, og:image:width, og:image:height (sdr-blog-post checklist item 18), and PostDetails.astro ignores frontmatter canonicalURL. Add an optional ogImageAlt field to the blog schema and pass it plus dimensions through; pass canonicalURL through. Also: no visible author byline on post pages (checklist 22).
